# Top 10 EV-Friendly Hotels in Malaysia: Best Family Stays with EV Charging 2026

**Last updated: May 18, 2026**

Malaysia has rapidly become one of Southeast Asia's most EV-ready countries. With the ChargeSini, Gentari, and JomCharge networks expanding across the peninsula, plus Tesla Superchargers arriving in KL, EV-driving families can now explore Malaysia with confidence. Destination charging at hotels has gone from rare to expected, especially in premium properties.

We've ranked Malaysia's top 10 EV-friendly hotels based on charger availability, speed, reliability, location, and overall family experience.

---

## 1. The Ritz-Carlton, Kuala Lumpur
**EV Rating: 9.7/10** | **Chargers:** 2× DC 150kW (Tesla Supercharger) + 4× AC 22kW (ChargeSini) | **Cost:** Free for guests | **Starting Rate:** RM 1,200/night

KL's premier luxury hotel has Malaysia's best in-hotel EV charging. Two Tesla V3 Superchargers in the valet basement deliver 150kW — add 300km of range in 15 minutes. The ChargeSini AC units handle non-Tesla EVs. Valet handles everything. The hotel's "Little Ritz Kids" program includes a scavenger hunt ending at the charging station. Near Petronas Twin Towers (0.8km) and Aquaria KLCC (1.2km).

---

## 2. Shangri-La Rasa Sayang, Penang
**EV Rating: 9.5/10** | **Chargers:** 3× AC 22kW (JomCharge) | **Cost:** Free for guests | **Starting Rate:** RM 850/night

Perched on Batu Feringghi's golden sands with three JomCharge AC units in covered parking near the lobby. A 3-hour charge adds ~120km. Adventure Zone indoor playground, 25-metre lagoon pool with water slide, complimentary kids' club (9am-6pm), and Chi Spa for parents. 500m from Batu Feringghi Night Market.

---

## 3. The Westin Desaru Coast Resort, Johor
**EV Rating: 9.4/10** | **Chargers:** 4× DC 50kW (Gentari) + 2× AC 11kW | **Cost:** Free for guests | **Starting Rate:** RM 700/night

Desaru Coast's premier family resort with Gentari DC chargers opposite the main entrance. A 25-minute charge adds 150km. Westin Family kids' club with science experiments, massive free-form pool with lazy river, and direct beach access. Desaru Coast Adventure Waterpark is a 3-minute walk.

---

## 4. The Datai Langkawi
**EV Rating: 9.3/10** | **Chargers:** 2× AC 22kW (EV Connection) | **Cost:** Free for guests | **Starting Rate:** RM 1,500/night

Tucked into a 10-million-year-old rainforest on Datai Bay. The EV Connection AC chargers are near the golf cart station. A single charge lasts 3 days on the small island. Nature Centre with guided rainforest walks, hornbill spotting, private infinity pool merging with the Andaman Sea.

---

## 5. Sunway Resort Hotel, Selangor
**EV Rating: 9.2/10** | **Chargers:** 6× DC 120kW (Sunway Charging Hub) + 10× AC 7kW | **Cost:** Free for guests | **Starting Rate:** RM 600/night

The fastest charging on this list — six 120kW DC units in the basement. Full charge for a Hyundai Ioniq 5 in under 25 minutes. Connected to Sunway Pyramid Mall and Sunway Lagoon theme park (6 parks: water, amusement, wildlife, extreme, scream, Nickelodeon). Can be busy on weekends.

---

## 6. Four Seasons Resort Langkawi
**EV Rating: 9.1/10** | **Chargers:** 1× AC 22kW (ChargeSini) + 1× Tesla Destination Charger | **Cost:** Free for guests | **Starting Rate:** RM 1,800/night

Intimate ultra-luxury on Tanjung Rhu beach. Valet charges your car and sends WhatsApp updates. "Kids for All Seasons" program (batik painting, kite-making, cooking classes). Island's best beach with crystal-clear water. Single charger — book ahead.

---

## 7. Hard Rock Hotel Penang
**EV Rating: 8.9/10** | **Chargers:** 2× AC 22kW (JomCharge) | **Cost:** Free for guests | **Starting Rate:** RM 450/night

Best value EV-friendly hotel in Malaysia. Massive free-form pool with water slide, rock climbing wall, recording studio for kids. Right on Batu Feringghi beach with hawker stalls steps away. "Rock the Family" package includes breakfast and RM 100 dining credit.

---

## 8. Mövenpick Hotel & Convention Centre KLIA
**EV Rating: 8.8/10** | **Chargers:** 4× DC 60kW (Gentari) + 2× AC 22kW | **Cost:** Free for guests | **Starting Rate:** RM 350/night

Perfect transit stop near KL International Airport. DC chargers in basement, rarely occupied. A 30-minute charge adds 200km range. Runway-view pool (kids love watching planes), indoor playground, chocolate hour at 4pm. Free shuttle to Mitsui Outlet Park.

---

## 9. The Majestic Hotel Kuala Lumpur
**EV Rating: 8.6/10** | **Chargers:** 1× AC 22kW (ChargeSini) + 1× Tesla Destination Charger | **Cost:** Free for guests | **Starting Rate:** RM 550/night

Heritage grande dame built in 1932 with white-glove valet charging service. "Heritage Explorer" package with guided tour of National Mosque and Merdeka Square (within 1km). Orchid Conservatory afternoon tea. Single charger — best for overnight stays.

---

## 10. Shangri-La Rasa Ria, Kota Kinabalu
**EV Rating: 8.5/10** | **Chargers:** 2× AC 11kW | **Cost:** Free for guests | **Starting Rate:** RM 650/night

Borneo's premier EV-friendly resort on a 64-acre nature reserve with orangutans. Overnight charging gives a full battery every morning. Kids' club with batik painting and nature walks, Adventure Zone with climbing wall and mini-golf. 40-min drive from KK Airport.

---

## Charging Networks in Malaysia
- **ChargeSini:** Nationwide, CCS2 & Type 2, credit card/e-wallet
- **Gentari:** Highway stops + cities, CCS2 & Type 2, Gentari app
- **JomCharge:** Penang & northern Malaysia, Type 2, JomCharge app
- **Tesla Supercharger:** KL, Penang, Johor Bahru, NACS (CCS2 adapter included)
- **EV Connection:** Langkawi, Penang, Type 2

## Tips
- The Singapore-KL-Penang run (700km): Charge at Ayer Keroh R&R (Gentari 180kW) and Ipoh R&R
- Call 24 hours before arrival to confirm charger availability
- Bring your own Type 2 cable for AC chargers
- Download PlugShare for community-checked station reliability

*Charging details accurate as of May 2026. Always verify charger availability with your hotel before booking.*
